How the Design Agent Works
It Thinks (Reasoning)
Unlike standard AI that just predicts pixels, Lovart's MCoT engine analyzes your intent. It asks 'Why?' before it decides 'How?', ensuring designs align with your market strategy.
It Plans (Orchestration)
The agent decomposes your request into tasks. It assigns a Logo Agent for branding, a Layout Agent for typography, and Nano Banana for high-fidelity rendering—all automatically.
It Collaborates (ChatCanvas)
Work on an infinite canvas where the Agent remembers context. Point to an object and say 'make this pop,' and the Agent executes edits with semantic understanding.

What makes Lovart an 'Agent' and not just a generator?

Traditional generators are passive; you prompt, they output. Lovart is active. It reasons, plans, breaks down tasks, and orchestrates multiple models to achieve a high-level business goal, maintaining context throughout the project.
Can the Agent maintain brand consistency?
Yes. Lovart's 'Design Context Core' allows the Agent to remember your brand's color palette, typography, and character styles, applying them consistently across all generated assets in a session.
Does the Agent support video creation?
Absolutely. The Design Agent integrates top video models like Veo 3 and Kling. You can turn any static design into a motion asset simply by asking the Agent to 'animate this'.
Is the content commercially usable?
Yes, users on paid plans have full commercial rights to the designs generated by the Agent, making it perfect for marketing campaigns, merchandise, and client work.
Do I need design skills to use the Agent?
No. The Agent is designed to bridge the gap between idea and execution. You provide the vision in natural language, and the Agent handles the technical design principles, layout, and rendering.
